## Publish gate report

**Going out:** About page copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** one fails.
  - "founded in Bristol in 2019" is on the policy list.
  - "a small team of six" is a product/team fact, fine as written.
  - "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" is on the policy list.
  - "we buy from gardens we've visited" is an origins statement, fine as written, but please confirm it is true.
  - **"Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars" is not on the policy list and has no source in this chat.** The only approved rating claim is "rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website". A 98% five-star figure is also a different measure, so it can't be treated as a rounding of that one.
- **Regulated claims:** nothing touching health, money, legal outcomes, environment, children or prices.
- **House style:** no banned words or AI tells. The tone is plain and fine.
- **Disclosure:** no ad, sponsorship, affiliate link or AI-labelled content, so no label is needed.

**Fixed:** I replaced the unproven stat with the approved rating claim.

> Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. We're rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website, and we buy from gardens we've visited.

**Needs a decision**
1. Confirm "we buy from gardens we've visited" is accurate. My suggestion is to keep it if so.
2. If you do have evidence for the 98% five-star figure, share the source and date so it can be added to the policy. Otherwise keep the 4.8 claim.

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so I need an explicit yes from you on the exact revised text above. Nothing is approved yet, and the original draft should not go out as written.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars", "type": "invented_stat"}], "publish": false}
```
